description:
Pay For S-Mods

Spoiler

this mod adds a configurable alternative to S-Modding ships, credits!

prices are fully configurable, three price models to select from, price based off hull size, OP Cost, or both!

this is my first mod, if you have any issues or suggestions feel free to comment and ill see what i can do

download here:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rCE23TXfZLQ3xLJECU6fAhjKSXQj3SFS/view?usp=drive_link
